additional_supported_gaps: Typed missing/refused errors and global sequential IDs disclose foreign job existence to admitted callers.
Job/project membership state is uncapped and result/retry settings unused.
One valid credential can fill global session capacity until close/expiry.
Malformed packet or mid-batch expiry can abort batch without per-item replies.
Authentication failures have no supplied admission audit.
Discovery schemas lack parameters/scopes; supplied tests omit revocation/isolation scenarios.
verdict.notes: Main finding supported; cancellation and completed replay coverage omitted. Scope-loss and no-read statements are conditional hardening because fixture credential table is immutable except disabling; report explicitly retains disable denial. “Not tenant-scoped” storage headline is imprecise, but paragraph explicitly retains owner/admin tenant controls. Grader confirmed absent named tests statically. No supplier recognition or full factory/host/lifetime assessment. No executed tests/external verification or deployment approval claimed.
